kurzbeschreibung: The Krimmler Wasserwelten combine a modern science museum and an energetic aquapark at the foot of the gigantic Krimmler Wasserfaelle.
beschreibung:
Experience the Fascination of Water Up Close

At the foot of Europe's largest waterfalls, the Krimmler Wasserwelten invite visitors on a playful journey of discovery. The modern visitor centre bridges solid natural science with hands-on interactive stations, illustrating the vital importance of alpine water.

Fun, Games, and Refreshing Kneipp Facilities

In the spacious outdoor aquapark area, young and old can experiment with water cannons, operate waterwheels, or cool down in Kneipp pools. The centre's panoramic viewing terrace commands an extraordinary view of the thundering cascades of water.
